question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from this yogic attainment?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is mentioned.
Seeing from very far away is mentioned.
Both are presented as resulting powers.
inference: This attainment removes wrinkles and grey hair and grants vision from very far away.
plain_english: One gains the removal of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
